headline: On last trading session, Sensex fell 319 points as inflation concerns snapped winning streak

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Inflation concerns and crude oil price pressures weighed on sentiment during the last session.
Profit taking dragged major benchmark indices lower after recent gains.
Global economic uncertainty and Federal Reserve rate expectations added pressure.
Weakness in key non-banking financial company (NBFC) stocks led the losses.
whatHappening: During the last trading session, Sensex dropped 319 points while Nifty50 closed at 25,144.
Manappuram Finance shares declined 4% in Friday's session.
Shriram Finance was among the top losers in the market wrap on November 13.
Indian markets maintained their 3rd straight week of gains despite Friday's market pullback.
summary: In the last trading session, Indian markets snapped their winning streak as Sensex fell 319 points and Nifty slid below 25,150. Inflation concerns and rising crude oil prices weighed on market sentiment, with financial stocks like Manappuram Finance and Shriram Finance declining. Overall, Indian indices managed to post gains for the third straight week.
